subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw publish `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in keyless Firecrawl web_search provider despite the current unauthenticated `/v2/search` 403 result?
rationale: This is not a mechanical code question: it creates a public provider id, routes search queries to a hosted service without credentials, and depends on an upstream access contract that did not succeed in a fresh probe.

options.title: Keep search credentialed for now
options.body: Do not merge this provider unless Firecrawl keyless search becomes a documented/stable contract and a maintainer sponsors the product/security boundary.

options.title: Accept after stronger proof
options.body: Allow the PR to continue only after fresh current-head live proof shows no-auth search succeeds and maintainers accept the opt-in privacy/support behavior.

options.title: Split the tool-option expansion
options.body: Consider landing only the keyed `firecrawl_search` option parity separately while leaving `firecrawl-free` out of the official provider catalog.

recommendation.title: Keep search credentialed for now
recommendation.body: Do not merge this provider unless Firecrawl keyless search becomes a documented/stable contract and a maintainer sponsors the product/security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the narrowed merged Firecrawl keyless scope and already framed keyless search as a separately sponsored future proposal.
